name: Are there special financing options available for new construction condos in Miami?

mainEntity.name: Are there special financing options available for new construction condos in Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: While traditional mortgages are common, some developers offer preferred lender programs or incentives for new construction properties, which can include rate buydowns or closing cost credits. However, securing financing for new construction typically requires that the building has received a Certificate of Occupancy and is able to be fully insured. A key decision factor is to engage with lenders early in the process to understand specific requirements and pre-qualify, as not all lenders finance unbuilt or newly completed projects.
acceptedAnswer.description: Special financing options for new construction condos may include developer incentives or preferred lender programs. It's crucial to consult with lenders early, as requirements differ for unbuilt properties.
